note: Batch 3 (Great Hypostyle Hall). Years BC are negative; reign dates follow Shaw (2000). Ids hypostyle-hall, sety-battle-reliefs, second-pylon-colossus, hypostyle-collapse and the people sety-i, ramesses-ii, georges-legrain, pinedjem-i already exist and are updated; second-pylon, hypostyle-restoration, hypostyle-cleaning, ramesses-i and horemheb are new.

things.name: the Second Pylon
things.who: built under Horemheb as a new western entrance, with its passage decorated by Ramesses I and recut by Ramesses II, and with talatat blocks from Akhenaten's temples in its core; it nearly fell in 1899 to 1900

things.name: the colossus by the Second Pylon
things.who: made for Ramesses II, with his daughter Bent'anta at his feet, and later re-inscribed by Ramesses VI and by the priest-king Pinedjem I (Digital Karnak lists Pinedjem first, but Ramesses VI ruled much earlier)

things.name: the Great Hypostyle Hall
things.who: begun by Sety I, who built its walls, columns and roof, and finished by Ramesses II, who completed the decoration; later Ramesses IV and Ramesses VI added cartouches to the central columns

things.name: Sety I's battle reliefs
things.who: carved for Sety I on the north outer wall of the Hypostyle Hall, showing his wars in Canaan, Lebanon, Syria and Libya; the Epigraphic Survey of Chicago recorded them in the 1970s and 1980s

things.name: the collapse of eleven Hypostyle columns
things.who: a chain reaction on 3 October 1899 that brought down eleven columns of the northern wing, blamed on weak foundations of small reused blocks in salty groundwater

things.name: Legrain's rebuilding of the Hypostyle columns
things.who: carried out by Georges Legrain, who took the fallen and damaged columns apart from December 1899, rebuilt the northern half on new foundations and underpinned the southern wing with brick, and recorded the work complete on 15 May 1902

things.name: the cleaning of the Hypostyle columns
things.who: carried out by Egyptian conservators of the Supreme Council of Antiquities, starting in July 2021 with the twelve central columns; in January 2024 the Council reported 95 per cent of the columns done, with their original engravings and colours revealed

people.name: Sety I
people.who: the Nineteenth Dynasty king who built most of the Hypostyle Hall and carved his wars on its north wall
events: began the Hypostyle Hall and, in his first year, marched into Canaan and Lebanon, shown on the east half of the north wall
died, leaving the south half of the hall to be decorated by Ramesses II

people.name: Ramesses I
people.who: the first king of the Nineteenth Dynasty and Sety I's father, who reigned under two years and left a decorated passage and a small station at the Second Pylon
events: died, after under two years on the throne

people.name: Horemheb
people.who: the last king of the Eighteenth Dynasty, a former general, who built the Second, Ninth and Tenth Pylons at Karnak using blocks from Akhenaten's temples
events: died, having built the Second, Ninth and Tenth Pylons at Karnak

people.name: Pinedjem I
people.who: a High Priest of Amun who ruled Thebes as king, and who had his name cut on the colossus of Ramesses II at the Second Pylon
events: took royal titles in Upper Egypt (about; sources vary)
